schema.description: Log of customer questions collected during the week, for the end-of-week survey on most common issues.

fields.language: Language of the customer's message (ISO 639-1 code)
fields.channel: Where the question arrived: whatsapp, web_chat, email, phone, other
fields.customer: Customer name if available, otherwise null
fields.question_raw: The question exactly as the customer wrote it
fields.question_en: Normalized English translation, for easy grouping in the weekly survey
fields.category: Topic of the question, used for the survey aggregation
fields.kb_ref: Path to the knowledge-base file that answers this question, or null if the KB has no answer yet

questions.question_raw: Hoe reinig ik de applicatiepad en de microvezeldoek na gebruik??
questions.question_en: How do I clean the applicator pad and microfibre cloth after use?
